messages:
lisa: Heads up — production tenant 'acme' started seeing duplicate SCIM user creates after IdP metadata rotation last night. provisioning shows two distinct externalIds for the same email.
ben: any obvious error in the SSO logs?
lisa: core log: `ERROR saml_parser: multiple_entity_descriptors picked_entity=urn:okta:org:new expected=urn:okta:org:old NameIDFormat=transient`
eli: summary from metadata-fetcher: Okta uploaded a bundle with two md:EntityDescriptor elements (old & new). our parser now sometimes picks the second entity, which changed default NameIDFormat.
andrew: timeline: okta-bot posted metadata for org-acme at 2026-03-19T22:14:03Z, fetcher polled and cached it immediately. some long-lived SP sessions had cached NameIDFormat=email — SCIM provisioning lambda saw two different externalId values within seconds -> duplicates.
oncall: paging SSO oncall to triage and confirm blast radius.
okta-bot: metadata-upload recorded for org-acme (id=2034) 2026-03-19T22:14:03Z.
ben: checked KMS/signature paths? fallback signature verification could cause double-issuance or re-sign.
eli: looked at kms and signature verification — no failures. both entity descriptors have valid signatures. root cause is ambiguity in choosing which entity descriptor maps to our SP entityID; NameIDFormat differs.
lisa: repro on staging by uploading dual-entity metadata: create user in Okta -> two SCIM create events arrive within 1-4s with different `externalId` hashes but same email.
andrew: mitigation proposal A (fast): add short dedupe in provisioning lambda: if a create for same email was created within last 60s, mark as potential duplicate and call reconcile path instead of plain create. low-risk, quick to ship.
ben: mitigation B: add runtime flag strict_nameid_match in SSO middleware to reject assertions that don't match configured NameIDFormat for tenant (fail closed for a short rollout window).
eli: I'll implement the dedupe flow + feature flag in staging EU and test. can do within 30m.
lisa: also adding an alert rule `sso.scim.duplicate_creates > 1 for 5m` -> page SSO oncall. writing runbook steps for merging duplicates and contacting IdP admin.
andrew: longer-term fix: update metadata-fetcher parser to prefer md:EntityDescriptor whose SPSSODescriptor contains our SP entityID in an <md:AssertionConsumerService> or explicit entityID match; also warn when multiple matching entity descriptors exist and surface to admin UI.
ben: small patch snippet for quick dedupe in provisioning lambda:```python
# quick dedupe guard
existing = scim_find_by_email(email)
if existing and (now - existing.created_at).total_seconds() < 60:
    publish_audit('sso:dup_provision', {'email': email, 'tenant': tenant})
    return reconcile_existing(existing, incoming_payload)
# else proceed to create
```
eli: deploying to staging now, enabling audit tag and alerting. will flip strict_nameid_match flag after observing for 15m.
lisa: also drafted a short support template to send to the tenant IdP admin asking them to remove duplicate EntityDescriptor entries or canonicalize NameID format and include the exact metadata snippet we expect.
andrew: assigning postmortem: I'll lead root-cause and remediation plan; @lisa to run backfill reconciliation for affected tenants; @eli to own the metadata-parser change.
oncall: acknowledged, standing by for prod deploy and pager updates.
lisa: thanks team. created follow-up ticket to add parser safety and tenant-level metadata validation in onboarding flow. :thumbsup:
